hook: TG SAFE: most eateries got *notices*, few suspensions
hook_b: TG SAFE: most eateries got *notices*, few suspensions
tldr: TG SAFE chief Avinash Mohanty said most inspected Hyderabad eateries got improvement or show-cause notices; suspension was used for extremely serious hazards.

beats.what: A restaurant owners' delegation led by MP Asaduddin Owaisi met the TG SAFE Commissioner on Nov 9.
beats.why: Several popular Hyderabad restaurants faced suspension and FSSAI licence cancellation in recent months.
beats.care: The rules being enforced are Schedule IV hygiene norms, in force since 2011, per the commissioner.

effects.label: Same rules for all, says chief

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: owners asked for improvement notices and time to fix deficiencies before any suspension, 'wherever legally permissible'.

cards.q: Before suspending a restaurant, should officials first issue an improvement notice?
opts: Yes, always give time to fix

learn.t: TG SAFE = Telangana Standards Authority for Food and Essential Drugs, the state food safety regulator.

fact: TG SAFE says only a *small share* of inspected restaurants faced suspension.
twist: Pista House, Shah Ghouse and Grand Hotel owners met the commissioner, asking for notices before shutdowns.
